t: Free computing units for ages 5 to 16 with lesson plans, slides and assessments.
steps: Open the Raspberry Pi Foundation teach page.
Choose the curriculum page for your country.
Download the unit overview for the age group you teach.
Read which lessons are unplugged and which need computers.
Check whether any lesson asks for an account.
Download the slides and activity sheets.
Ask IT before students use any online tool the unit names.
